title: Implementation, needs coverage, and effectiveness of outpatient versus inpatient work-related medical rehabilitation (WMR) in cardiac, neurological, oncological, and psychosomatic rehabilitation - survey of of individuals who attended WMR
summary: A primary goal of medical rehabilitation on behalf of the German Pension Insurance (DRV) is to promote work participation. Therefore, the work-related medical rehabilitation (WMR) was introduced approximately 15 years ago and has since become established nationwide. As part of the present study, individuals undergoing WMR are surveyed regarding (1) their perceived work-related needs, (2) the implementation of WMR measures, and (3) their setting preferences (inpatient vs. outpatient).

interventions.name: Survey of individuals who have completed a neurological, cardiological, oncological, or psychosomatic WMR-measure within the past three months

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Completion of a neurological, cardiological, oncological, or psychosomatic WMR service within the past three months
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria are derived from the inclusion criteria.
